---
title: "Repository, Quarto and GitHub Pages"
---

## Get the material

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR-ORG/fastq-to-genome.git
cd fastq-to-genome
git pull          # get updates during the course
```

## Preview this site locally

Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/), then:

```bash
quarto preview    # opens the site and refreshes when you save a page
quarto render     # builds the static site in _site/
```

## Publish with GitHub Pages (instructors)

1. Push the repository to GitHub.
2. In **Settings → Pages**, choose **Source: GitHub Actions**.
3. The workflow `.github/workflows/publish.yml` builds and deploys the site at every push to `main`.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Keep the answers private
`solutions/` is **not** part of the website (it is not in the `render` list of `_quarto.yml`), but it is still in the
repository. For a public repository, keep it on a private branch, or delete it before sharing and publish it after the session.
:::

## Where things are

| Folder | Content |
|---|---|
| `data/` | reference genomes, FASTQ, outbreak genomes, metadata |
| `scripts/` | numbered steps (`01`–`15`) |
| `exercises/` | module 1 instructions and the answer sheet |
| `precomputed/` | plan B outputs |
| `course/` | the pages of this site |
